name: validate-harnessability-assessment-skill
description: Single-shot dogfood agent. Runs the harnessability-assessment skill (read-only, static, network off) against an already-cloned target repo, then INDEPENDENTLY verifies the outputs — report files exist (incl. root latest.json + a per-run history dir), report.json validates against the skill's schema, the two-axis tuple + grade are present, and 2-3 evidence claims are spot-checked against the real tree. Emits a PASS/FAIL verdict plus a dual-layer magic-wand retrospective (the harnessability-assessment skill vs minih).
author: AI-Substrate

files.description: Mission: cd to project root, invoke the harnessability-assessment skill against targetRepo, independently validate its outputs, verdict + dual-layer retrospective. Documents how the skill is wired into minih (.minih.json skills block / --skill-source+--skill).

Rules: drive the skill (don't reimplement it), independent verification is mandatory (don't trust the self-report), prefer --json, static/read-only with network off, capture friction at the moment of friction tagged skill|minih.
Params: targetRepo (abs path to the clone), mode (static|safe-probe|deep, default static).

Structured report: targetRepo, assessmentResult (report paths + grades + finalGrade), validation (per-check pass/fail), verdict (PASS|FAIL), summary, and retrospective (workedWell/confusing/magicWand/magicWandTarget/difficulties).
